title: 第5章 暂时互相妥协，贴脸输出
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

许景川被带到了警署后门旁边巷子里停着的一辆黑色豪华轿车前。

车窗拉上了帘子看不见内部。

“许队长，请。”

平头青年抬手示意。

许景川拉开后排车门的瞬间，就嗅到一股淡淡的橘子香扑面而来。

姜欢正翘着二郎腿，以一个极为放松的姿势坐在内侧的座椅上，神态悠哉的用小锉刀磨着指甲。

米白色西装搭配同色套裙和裸色高跟鞋，薄如蝉翼的肉色丝袜包裹着的双腿修长夺目。

由于坐姿的原因臀部侧面曲线格外饱满，薄薄的布料被绷成了圆弧。

“许队长，再看就不礼貌了。”她停下手上动作，侧头微微一笑道。

许景川钻入车内关上了门。

“让姜老板见笑了，主要是你这么漂亮有气质的美女实在太少见。”

“是吗？”姜欢撩了撩垂下的发丝莞尔一笑，“比照片上还漂亮？”

“是。”许景川回以笑容。

姜欢笑容略微收敛，水润的红唇轻启，“你这么大胆的人也很少见。”

“没办法，咱不像姜老板生来就锦衣玉食，胆子不大的话，早被人给吃了，是真的吃，姜老板见过吗？”

许景川目光平静，语气也平静。

姜欢并没有被吓到，而是饶有兴致的问了一句，“是听说过在无政府区有这种事，许队长也遇到过吗？”

“没有。”许景川摇摇头，笑吟吟的说道：“那些混得差、无米下锅的人才这样子，我混得还行，犯不着。”

杀人他眼睛都不眨。

吃人还是算了吧，太变态。

他倒是喜欢被人吃。

当然，有时候也可以帮人吃，比如姜欢这种，他就乐得抱饮饱食。

“饿不着和吃好是两回事，明人不说暗话，照片你开个价吧。”姜欢结束了试探，开门见山的摊牌。

许景川摇了摇头，“钱，没人不喜欢，但有的钱我可不敢拿，照片给了你，你真会放过我这个知情者？”

“刚刚还说许队长胆子大，看来也蛮小的。”姜欢嗤笑一声，冷淡的说道：“你现在大小也是有了一层官身，你觉得我有胆子杀官吗？”

“我可不是赖德全，我更清楚这个世界的底色。”许景川盯着她一字一句的说道：“一个为了钱连亲爹都敢杀的人，还有什么是她不敢的？”

“你住口！”姜欢瞬间红温，情绪激动的的呵斥，狠狠怒视着他咬牙切齿说道：“自以为是！自作聪明！”

“可能是吧，我也没兴趣去了解什么内幕，反正照片不会给你，除非哪天我官大了，不怕你了，到时候送你也无妨。”许景川轻飘飘的说道。

原本他还想用照片威胁姜欢吃她一辈子的：小姐，你也不想……

但经过和赖德全沟通和刚刚短暂的试探后，他就打消了这个念头。

介娘们儿真不是啥善茬啊。

把她逼急了自己讨不到好处。

只能试着退而求其次，看能不能从胁迫她屈服，变成逼着她合作。

姜欢被气乐了，“你以为我是蠢货吗？等你官大了用照片控制我？”

“这不满意的话，那就你给个双方都满意的方案吧。”许景川一副摆烂的态度，把皮球又踢了回去。

姜欢高耸的胸脯起伏不定，阴着脸沉思片刻后说道：“行，照片我可以先不要，但你得去帮我做件事。”

Page (1/3)

Xu Jingchuan was taken to a black luxury car parked in the alley next to the back door of the police station.

The window was closed and the interior could not be seen.

"Captain Xu, please."

The young man with a flat head raised his hand to signal.

The moment Xu Jingchuan opened the rear door, he smelled a faint scent of orange.

Jiang Huan was sitting on the seat inside with her legs crossed in an extremely relaxed posture, sharpening her nails with a small file in a leisurely manner.

An off-white suit is paired with a skirt of the same color and nude high heels. The legs wrapped in thin flesh-colored stockings are eye-catching.

Due to the sitting posture, the curves on the side of the hips are particularly full, and the thin fabric is stretched into a circular arc.

"Captain Xu, it would be rude to look at you any further." She stopped her movements, turned her head and smiled.

Xu Jingchuan got into the car and closed the door.

"It makes Boss Jiang laugh. The main reason is that such a beautiful and elegant woman like you is so rare."

"Really?" Jiang Huan teased her hanging hair and smiled, "She's more beautiful than in the photo?"

"Yes." Xu Jingchuan smiled back.

Jiang Huan's smile faded slightly, her moist red lips parted slightly, "It's rare to see someone as bold as you."

"There is nothing we can do. Unlike Boss Jiang, we were born with fine clothes and good food. If we were not brave enough, we would have been eaten by others. We really ate it. Have you seen Boss Jiang?"

Xu Jingchuan's eyes were calm and his tone was calm.

Jiang Huan was not frightened, but asked with interest, "Have you heard of such a thing happening in the anarchy zone? Has Captain Xu ever encountered it?"

"No." Xu Jingchuan shook his head and said with a smile: "Those who have a bad life and have no rice to cook are like this. I have a good life and can't do it."

He kills people without blinking an eye.

Forget it about cannibalism, it's too perverted.

He actually likes to be eaten.

Of course, sometimes you can help others eat, like Jiang Huan, who is happy to eat and drink.

"Being hungry and being well fed are two different things. I won't tell anyone secretly. Just give me a price for the photos." Jiang Huan ended the probing and went straight to the point of the showdown.

Xu Jingchuan shook his head, "No one dislikes money, but I don't dare to take the money I have. I gave you the photo. Will you really let me, the insider?"

"I just said that Captain Xu is brave, but he seems to be quite young." Jiang Huan sneered and said coldly: "You are now an official, do you think I have the courage to kill an official?"

"I'm not Lai Dequan, I know the background of this world better." Xu Jingchuan stared at her and said word by word: "A person who dares to kill his own father for money, what else can she not dare to do?"

"Shut up!" Jiang Huan instantly became red-hot and scolded him emotionally. She glared at him fiercely and gritted her teeth and said, "You are self-righteous! You are so smart!"

"Maybe so. I'm not interested in knowing the inside story. Anyway, I won't give you the photos. Unless one day I grow up and am no longer afraid of you, then it won't hurt to give them to you." Xu Jingchuan said lightly.

Originally, he wanted to use the photo to threaten Jiang Huan to eat her for the rest of her life: Miss, you don’t want to either...

But after communicating with Lai Dequan and just a brief trial, he gave up this idea.

It's really not a good thing to be a nanny.

You won't get any benefits by pushing her too hard.

I can only try to do the next best thing and see if I can go from coercing her to submit to coercing her to cooperate.

Jiang Huan was infuriated, "Do you think I'm a fool? When you get older, you'll use photos to control me?"

"If you're not satisfied with this, then you can come up with a plan that satisfies both parties." Xu Jingchuan kicked the ball back with a show-off attitude.

Jiang Huan's towering chest rose and fell, and after thinking for a moment with a sullen face, he said, "Okay, I don't need the photo, but you have to go and do something for me."
